name: Transitive Property of Equality
description: If A=B and B=C, then A=C

name: Reflexive Property
description: Any geometric figure is congruent to itself. A=A

name: Segment Addition Postulate
description: If B is between A and C, then AB + BC = AC

name: Angle Addition Postulate
description: If D is in the interior of Angle ABC, then Angle ABD + Angle DBC = Angle ABC

name: Linear Pair Postulate
description: If two angles form a linear pair, they are supplementary.

name: Vertical Angles Theorem
description: Vertical angles are equal in measure.

name: Corresponding Angles Postulate
description: If two parallel lines are cut by a transversal, then corresponding angles are equal.

name: Alternate Interior Angles Theorem
description: If two parallel lines are cut by a transversal, alternate interior angles are equal.

name: Triangle Angle Sum
description: Sum of interior angles of a triangle is 180 degrees.

name: Isosceles Base Angles Theorem
description: If two sides of a triangle are equal, the angles opposite those sides are equal.

name: SAS Congruence Postulate
description: If two sides and the included angle of one triangle are congruent to two sides and the included angle of another, the triangles are congruent.

name: SSS Congruence Postulate
description: If three sides of one triangle are congruent to three sides of another, the triangles are congruent.

name: ASA Congruence Postulate
description: If two angles and the included side of one triangle are congruent to two angles and the included side of another, the triangles are congruent.
